    About Quandela:

    Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
    Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
    Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

    Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

    Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

    About this position:

    You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

    Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

    Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

    Requirements

    What you'll do:

    As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

    • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
    • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
    • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
    • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
    • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
    • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
    • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

    You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
    -

    How you'll grow:

    During your first 3–6 months 
    Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

    Within 1 year 
    Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

    Longer term 
    Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

    --

    What we're looking for:
    We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

    Must-have 

    • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
    • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
    • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
    • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
    • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
    • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
    • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
    • Professional English. 

    Important, but you can grow here 

    • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
    • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
    • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
    • Noise modelling. 
    • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
    • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

    Bonus 

    • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
    • Photonic quantum computing. 
    • Resource estimation. 
    • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
    • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

    You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

    Benefits

    Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

    • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
    • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
    • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
    • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

    Plus: 

    • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
    • Company savings plan.
    • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
    • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
    • Swile meal vouchers. 
    • Access to Gymlib. 

    Process 

    • Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min
    • Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min
    • Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team 
    • Reference checks 
    • Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic
    • Offer 

    For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem.

    About Alta Ares


    Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

    Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

    Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

    Role & Mission

    Business Development & Pipeline Generation

    • Build and manage a qualified pipeline across the Baltic region.

    • Identify and engage key stakeholders across MODs, armed forces, procurement agencies, and defense companies

    • Conduct targeted outbound prospecting through email, phone, LinkedIn, events, and industry networks

    • Research accounts, programs, procurement cycles, and decision-makers to identify new opportunities

    • Qualify prospects and convert them into meetings, demos, and active sales opportunities

    • Maintain accurate CRM data, pipeline tracking, and business development metrics

    • Work closely with the Sales Director and senior BD team to progress qualified opportunities

    • Provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer feedback to the BD, Product, Engineering, and leadership teams



    Customer & Partner Relationships

    • Build relationships with military users, procurement officers, program managers, primes, and integrators

    • Identify and develop potential local industry and channel partnerships

    • Support customer meetings, product briefings, demonstrations, and workshops

    • Represent Alta Ares at defense exhibitions, conferences, and industry events across the Baltic region


      Candidate profile

    • 1–4 years of experience in business development, sales development, defense, technology, consulting, or a related field

    • Proven ability to prospect, research accounts, generate meetings, and build pipeline

    • Strong interest in defense, aerospace, AI, or national security

    • Familiarity with the Baltic defense ecosystem

    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills

    • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable with outbound prospecting

    • Fluent in English

    • Willingness to travel regularly across the Baltics region.


    Nice to Have

    • Experience in defense, aerospace, dual-use technology, AI, or a high-growth startup

    • Existing network within Baltics defense organizations or industry

Your Role & How we work<\/strong>

As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m\/f\/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.<\/p>

The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.<\/span><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Your role and responsibilities<\/strong>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.<\/span><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.<\/span><\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.<\/span><\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.<\/span><\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.<\/span><\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior<\/span><\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • .<\/span><\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Run what you build<\/span><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software\/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.<\/span><\/p><\/li>

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to both open-source client code and related backend services, with an emphasis on networking features and optimizations
  • Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making
  • Work with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features that enhance networking capabilities

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core networking software components.
  • Exhibit ownership over the running services that comprise Tailscale’s product by building for observability, participating in incident response, and fielding customer support escalations.
  • Analyze and improve the efficiency, scalability, and stability of networking systems and resources.
  • Bring a security-first mindset to both design and implementation, ensuring robust and secure networking components.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience implementing application-layer networking concepts and distributed components, such as proxies, connectors, and overlay routing, to enable seamless connectivity.
  • Deep knowledge of operating system-level networking internals, including socket programming, routing tables, and packet filtering primitives.
  • Professional experience with Go (Golang)
  • Experience designing and maintaining distributed systems, with a solid understanding of concurrency (e.g., multithreading, race conditions, memory management, synchronization primitives) and scalability.
  • Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and writing efficient SQL queries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
  • Strong collaborative mindset—you actively give and process constructive feedback and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Startup-ready flexibility, with the adaptability to pivot and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$242,540—$302,840 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

The AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL) is an applied research initiative studying how workforce conditions influence delivery of mission-critical investments and public programs. WIL builds methodology-transparent workforce intelligence and applied public-safety and justice research capacity — including veterans justice, diversion, and reentry TTA support packaged for grant and sponsored-research pursuits.

Learn more:

We engage experienced practitioners for both full-time employment and project-based contract roles, depending on the award and staffing model. Engagements are remote-first with travel as required for partner and field sites. We build ready teams for live grant and sponsored-research pursuits — not speculative staffing banks.

This opportunity is contingent upon grant or sponsored-project award and final staffing approval. Permission will be requested before including a candidate's name or resume in a proposal or funding package.

WIL is seeking a Veterans Justice Programs Specialist to design and deliver training, technical assistance, and program-improvement support for justice-involved veterans — including diversion, treatment courts, reentry, behavioral-health linkages, and veteran-serving partnerships — as applied research and TTA capacity for WIL grant packages.

What you'll do:
Assess veterans justice program needs across courts, corrections, behavioral health, and veteran-serving partners
Design and deliver TTA, curricula, and implementation coaching for veterans treatment courts, diversion, and reentry models
Help partners strengthen screening, case coordination, peer support, and connections to VA and community resources
Develop practical tools, performance measures, and knowledge products for the field
Contribute specialist qualifications and past-performance narrative to WIL grant and sponsored-research packages when permissioned

Requirements

Required:

Demonstrated experience with veterans justice, veterans treatment courts, justice-involved veterans programs, or closely related reentry and diversion work
Experience delivering training or technical assistance to justice, behavioral-health, or veteran-serving partners
Strong facilitation, curriculum or toolkit development, and written-deliverable skills
Open to full-time employment or project-based contract engagement; remote-first with travel as partner and field work requires

Nice to have:

Direct experience with VA partnerships, Veterans Justice Outreach, or peer-support models for justice-involved veterans
Familiarity with federal justice TTA and national center models
Prior engagements you can cite (agency/partner, your role, year)

🌟 Csatlakozz a Xeropanhoz részmunkaidős Social Media & Content Managerként!

A Xeropannál folyamatosan történik valami: új AI-funkciók készülnek, új iskolák és egyetemek csatlakoznak, nemzetközi partnerekkel dolgozunk, új termékeket és funkciókat indítunk, eseményeken veszünk részt.

Jelenleg azonban nincs egyetlen ember, aki ezekből tudatosan és rendszeresen Xeropan-történeteket épít a social médiában.

Ezt szeretnénk rád bízni.

Nem egyszerűen valakit keresünk, aki posztokat készít és publikál. Olyan kollégát keresünk, aki figyeli, mi történik a cégnél, felismeri benne a kommunikációs lehetőségeket, és ownershipet vállal azért, hogy a megfelelő történet a megfelelő közönséghez, a megfelelő csatornán és formában eljusson.

  • a cégen belüli hírek, fejlesztések, eredmények és történetek folyamatos figyelése;

A vizuális tartalmak elkészítésében nem leszel egyedül: a marketingcsapatban van kreatív támogatás, és szorosan együtt dolgozol majd a Head of Branddel és más Xeropan csapatokkal is.

A rövid videós formátum fontos része lesz a munkának. Olyan embert keresünk, aki érti, mitől működik egy TikTok-, Reels- vagy Shorts-videó, és ideális esetben időnként maga is komfortosan megjelenik ezekben.

  • dolgoztál már márkák social kommunikációján;
  • jól ismered az Instagram, TikTok, Facebook és YouTube működését;
  • érted, hogy ugyanaz az üzenet miért nem működik ugyanúgy minden platformon;
  • önállóan gondolkodsz és kezdeményezel;
  • nem arra vársz, hogy valaki mindig megmondja a következő feladatot;
  • természetesen keresed a kommunikálható történeteket;
  • szeretsz rendszert építeni és ownershipet vállalni;
  • gyorsan tudsz kísérletezni és iterálni;

Előny

  • van organikus social growth tapasztalatod;
  • készítettél már TikTok-, Reels- vagy Shorts-tartalmakat;

Különösen jó fit lehetsz, ha szereted azt mondani: „ezt én viszem.”

Van termékünk, van felhasználói bázisunk, van rengeteg történetünk, innovációnk és eredményünk.

Jelentkezéshez küldd el:

Nem tökéletesen kipipált CV-t keresünk. Olyan embert keresünk, aki bele akar állni ebbe a történetbe, és azt akarja érezni: „ezt én építettem fel.” 🚀

Az elmúlt időszakban a növekedésünk fókuszában elsősorban a termékfejlesztés, az intézményi értékesítés és a performance marketing állt.

Most szeretnénk felépíteni ennek egy új, erős pillérét:

a Xeropan tudatos, következetes és kreatív social media jelenlétét.

Ehhez keresünk olyan embert, aki ezt a területet valóban a sajátjának érzi.

Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.

Chez Thirdbridge, nous créons des applications et des solutions logicielles sur mesure depuis plus d'une décennie. Au-delà du code, nous sommes fiers de réunir des passionné·es de technologie au cœur d'une culture inégalable avec qui nous imaginons des expériences numériques que les utilisateurs aiment pour de vrai.

Le·la PM/PO IA sera responsable de coordonner les projets. En travaillant conjointement avec les équipes de design et de développement, il·elle combinera ses compétences en gestion de produit et de projets agiles pour livrer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins clients, et qui se testent avant même d'être construites.

Les principales responsabilités

  • Recevoir, évaluer et gérer les demandes clients en assurant un constant alignement avec la stratégie produit;
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil dans la relation client;
  • Prototyper rapidement des idées produit avec des outils d'IA générative pour valider des hypothèses avant d'impliquer les équipes de développement;
  • Utiliser l'IA activement au quotidien : générer du code fonctionnel, rédiger des specs, créer des maquettes, automatiser des tâches;
  • Conseil stratégique en transformation numérique et IA. Diagnostiquer la maturité d'un client, cartographier son écosystème et livrer une feuille de route de transformation priorisée.
  • Organiser et animer des ateliers avec le client et l’équipe: Mener des entrevues et synthétiser les constats en présentations claires pour des décideurs.
  • Mettre en place des objectifs mesurables, analyser les données et les KPIs et assurer une rétroaction à l'équipe;
  • Gérer les budgets et les échéanciers liés aux projets et prendre les décisions adéquates lorsqu'ils sont impactés;
  • Gérer et prioriser le backlog produit et design en collaboration avec le chef d'équipe (rédaction d'epics,user stories, etc.);
  • Superviser le processus d'assurance qualité tout en y participant activement;
  • Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie du produit, de la conception à la livraison et à la maintenance;
  • Garantir un alignement constant entre les livrables et la vision produit.

Finalement, nous cherchons quelqu'un qui n'attend pas que tout soit parfait pour tester une idée, quelqu'un qui prototype avant de planifier et propose des solutions proactives plutôt que réactives. Quelqu’un qui a du goût et de l’expérience avec des clients mais qui est aussi technique. Tu relèveras de la Directrice produit.

Le profil recherché

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets et/ou gestion de produits numériques;

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit;
  • Tu utilises activement l'IA dans ton travail;
  • Tu es à l'aise avec le vibe coding : tu sais diriger un agent de développement IA pour produire des prototypes fonctionnels rapidement, et tu comprends ce que tu génères assez pour en valider la qualité;
  • Tu connais bien les concepts de base du design UX/UI et de l'outil Figma;

Un gros plus si :

  • Tu as une connaissance de l'industrie du commerce de détail, des programmes de fidélisation, des stratégies marketing propres à cette industrie et de la ludification de produits numériques;

Les avantages de travailler avec nous

En passant, notre processus de recrutement est simple et rapide :

About Us

At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.

We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.

At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on and accountable Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead, design, and execute our enterprise-wide security strategy. The ideal candidate will be both a strategic thinker and a tactical leader—capable of driving policy, governance, and compliance, while also being technically proficient and actively involved in day-to-day security operations.

This role is for a builder and protector, someone who thrives on creating secure systems, proactively managing risks, and ensuring that security is embedded into every aspect of our business, technology, and culture.

Responsibilities

  • Security Strategy & Governance
    • Define and lead the company's information security vision, roadmap, and operating model.
    • Align security initiatives with business goals, ensuring risk-based prioritization.
    • Drive security posture maturity across infrastructure, cloud, applications, and endpoints.
  • Operational Leadership
    • Oversee and manage the security operations center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management.
    • Build and run playbooks for threat mitigation and breach containment.
    • Ensure rapid, high-quality incident resolution.
  • Technical Involvement
    • Stay deeply engaged in security architecture reviews, secure SDLC practices, penetration testing, and cloud security configurations.
    • Review and enforce policies for identity and access management (IAM), zero trust architecture, encryption, and secure networking.
    • Work closely with engineering, IT, DevOps, and product teams on secure-by-design implementation.
  • Compliance & Risk Management
    • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, NIST).
    • Lead internal and external audits, risk assessments, and vendor security reviews.
    • Develop and maintain a robust business continuity and disaster recovery plan.
  • Customer Engagement
    • Engage with the field to support customer interactions when needed
    • Pro-actively build and maintain relationships with key peers and CISOs at customers, and establish credibility
  • Leadership & Culture
    • Foster a culture of security awareness and accountability across the organization.
    • Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing security team.
    • Communicate risks, incidents, and KPIs to executive leadership and the board.

Summary
The Payroll and People Operations Administrator is a critical support role that combines core HR administration with end-to-end payroll and timekeeping. Success in this role means payroll runs on time and without errors, employee records are complete and audit-ready, and departmental processes and workflows are executed flawlessly.

Responsibilities
Payroll & Timekeeping
This role assists with the following duties:
• Verify hours worked and pay adjustments each pay period, and post approved information to payroll records.
• Enter payroll data into the payroll system, and process and issue employee pay and earnings statements.
• Review timesheets, wage computations, and related records to detect and resolve payroll discrepancies before payroll is finalized.
• Process certified payroll for covered employees, and ensure compliance with federal contractor payroll requirements, including the Davis-Bacon and Related Acts, McNamara O’Hara Service Contract Act, and Prevailing Wages.
• Partner with People Operations on matters affecting employee pay, such as compensation changes, leaves of absence, and earnings and deductions changes.
• Assist employees and managers on the company’s timekeeping system and procedures as needed.
• Stay current on final pay and changes in tax and deduction laws that affect payroll processing per state.

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle
This role supports the People Operations team with the following duties:
• Perform new hire onboarding tasks as the need arises.
• Conduct reference or background checks on existing employees as directed by customer requirements.
• Facilitate the employee separation process, including the coordination of final pay, equipment collection, and access shut off.
• Partner with the company’s employment verification provider to facilitate requests, completing those that fall outside of the provider’s scope.
• Review and process employee changes in the HRIS, including demographic changes, benefit elections, and process workflows.

Education & Experience Requirements
Required
• Two (2) or more years of combined experience in payroll processing and HR administration, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
• Experience processing multi-step payroll, including wage and deduction calculations, timekeeping review, and pay adjustments.
• Experience processing certified payroll and working with federal contractor requirements, including but not limited to: Davis-Bacon and Related Acts, McNamara-O’Hara Service Contract Act, and Prevailing Wages.
• Working knowledge of payroll tax and deduction rules and core employment laws (such as FLSA, EEO, and ADA), with the ability to apply them to day-to-day situations.
• Experience using an HRIS, payroll, or timekeeping platform (for example Paylocity, ADP, Workday, UKG/Kronos, or similar) and Microsoft Excel for reconciliation and reporting.
• Strong accuracy and attention to detail, including the ability to spot and resolve numerical discrepancies.
• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain pay and policy information to people at all levels.
• Able to handle confidential employee and pay information with discretion and in accordance with company data-protection practices.

Preferred
• Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, accounting, or a related field. Equivalent experience is fully considered.
• Professional certification such as Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), Certified Payroll Professional (CPP), aPHR, PHR, or SHRM-CP.
• Experience supporting a multi-state workforce or a federal government contractor environment.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands below represent those needed to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
• Remaining in a stationary position, typically seated, for extended periods while working at a computer.
• Operating a computer and other standard office equipment, including frequent keyboard and data-entry work.
• Reviewing detailed information on screens and in documents for accuracy.
• Communicating with employees, managers, and external parties daily by phone, email, video conference, and in person.
• A standard 40-hour work week, with occasional periods of heightened workload around payroll deadlines and period-end close.

About the Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL)

WIL provides workforce and execution intelligence for construction, infrastructure, energy, power, data centers, and other capital-intensive markets, and is expanding work with federal, state, and local government agencies where data, research, workforce intelligence, and subject-matter expertise can address public-sector problems.

Learn more:

We engage experienced practitioners for both full-time employment and project-based contract roles, as applicable to the award and staffing model. Engagements are remote-first with travel as required for partner and field sites. We build ready teams for live grant and sponsored-research pursuits.

This opportunity is contingent upon grant or sponsored-project award and final staffing approval. Permission will be requested before including a candidate's name or resume in a proposal or funding package.

WIL is seeking a Strategic Senior Advisor with significant government contracting experience: someone who has operated inside the government contracting ecosystem and can help WIL avoid the mistakes organizations make when entering or scaling in that market.

This named relationship is a Strategic Senior Advisor role rather than an immediate full-time operating seat. The expected commitment is limited: periodic strategic conversations, review of selected opportunities or decisions, and introductions where you independently believe they make sense. Where WIL needs substantial execution, such as capture support, proposal development, contract strategy, or partner work, that can be scoped separately as full-time employment or a project-based contract.

The experience we are looking for includes several of the following: federal, state, or large municipal government contracting; capture strategy and opportunity qualification; RFP, RFQ, and RFI evaluation and bid or no-bid decisions; proposal strategy and competitive positioning; FAR, DFARS, and government procurement processes; IDIQs, BPAs, GWACs, GSA schedules, or similar vehicles; prime and subcontractor teaming; agency relationship development; contract compliance and post-award execution; professional services, research, analytics, workforce, infrastructure, technology, or consulting contracts; building or scaling a government contracting function.

Experience as a government contracting executive, former contracting or procurement leader, capture executive, government practice leader, or senior operator at an established federal contractor is particularly relevant.

What you'll help WIL decide

Which opportunities to pursue and which to walk away from
Where the government buying process is likely to be underestimated
What capabilities are needed before pursuing larger contracts
When to prime versus partner
What makes an agency take a newer entrant seriously
What mistakes create problems after an award
How to build this capability without unnecessary overhead

Requirements

Required

Substantial government-contracting execution experience, not title alone
Judgment that will challenge assumptions rather than confirm them
Ability to join periodic remote strategic conversations
Open to full-time employment or project-based contract engagement; remote-first with travel as partner and field work requires

Nice to have

FAR or DFARS, IDIQ, BPA, GWAC, or GSA schedule experience
Capture, proposal, or post-award compliance leadership
Professional-services, research, analytics, workforce, infrastructure, or technology contracts

About Us:

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

Bold in how we dream and innovate

The Role

In this role, we are looking for an intelligent, passionate person to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) team. The SOC team is responsible for the day-to-day accuracy of our products, monitoring customer data for new threats and reacting quickly when such threats occur. The team uses a follow-the sun-model and works closely with the Engineering, Support and Technical Services teams who highly value a close working relationship with the SOC.

As a member of this team, you will be working with some of the largest Internet Service Providers and Mobile Operators to ensure the highest level of threat detection, analysis and high-quality response. No two days are alike within the SOC as you react to attacks and work on broader research into our data. We’re looking for people who don’t just see an email or text message but instead see patterns or anti-abusive behavior and understand how our products see those messages. We’re looking for people with a curious mind to find ways to improve our products to detect and stop threats quickly.

  • Use best practices to develop innovative automation and tooling that can improve our resilience to new and emerging threats

  • Document threats and trends for internal and external communication

  • Provide support for users submitting CSI remediation requests

  • Operate within a 24x7 follow-the-sun environment (no

  • 5 years experience within the anti-abuse email deliverability, threat or other security research fields

  • Demonstrates strong analytical and creative problem-solving abilities

  • Good understanding of the Internet and how malicious actors use available resources

  • Strong technical experience with email, mobile, DNS or other messaging technologies

  • Proficiency in Shell & Go preferred, Perl and Python are ok

  • Strong communication skills both verbally and in writing in English,

  • Document and report findings to the team

  • Good knowledge of using SIEM tools such as Splunk or Kibana

  • Familiarity with SQL

Nice to have

OEC provides software solutions to those who work in the automotive parts and repair industry. Our solutions make it easier for automotive industry professionals to buy and sell parts, conduct repair research & planning, optimize estimates, improve the parts supply chain, and more. OEC partners with many of the world’s largest manufacturers, dealers and suppliers, shops and repairers, and service providers, giving our customers access to a comprehensive network and a streamlined workflow.

Job Summary

Provides comprehensive and executive-level administrative support to OEC’s Senior Vice President of Collision. Assists in the development and execution of strategic plans, often involving research and analysis. Supports the operations of multiple collision business units including organization and action planning related to budget, staffing and preparation and completion of executive deliverables. Coordinates a variety of meetings and events for individuals and groups requiring complex calendar and logistics management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides the highest level of support to the Senior Vice President of our Collision SBU; anticipates leadership needs and gathers appropriate resources to support and address current business priorities; facilitates communication between the senior leadership team and other teams, departments, and external stakeholders.
  • Manages multiple projects or tasks with competing priorities and deadlines independently and/or in collaboration with multiple team members or external partners; develops and maintains procedures to ensure senior leadership team is prepared to meet upcoming deadlines.
  • Creates agendas, reports, presentations, and other documents for meetings and events.
  • Tracks department expenses, staffing levels to ensure alignment with budgets and capacity requirements. Helps with forecasting and action plans related to revenue and expense reporting insights.
  • Plans, schedules and facilitates details for meetings, seminars, and events, both internally and offsite.
  • Manages a high volume of domestic and foreign travel arrangements, including applying for visas where required, preparing country information, booking flights, and making reservations. Modifies arrangements as needed, and ensures updated details are quickly distributed to travelers.
  • Prepares expense reports (which may include currency conversion), reconciles corporate credit card statements, and prepares various forms such as purchase requisitions and check requests to expedite processing and payment.
  • Assists the Senior Vice President with follow-up and tracking of major deliverables. Prepares routine and advanced correspondence including letters, memoranda, and reports (including professional visuals such as graphs, charts and infographics) and distributes to elicit desired call to action and responses.
  • Anticipates the needs of the Senior Vice President and prepares all resources accordingly. Manages internal and external contacts proactively; responds to incoming requests as the Executive Office point of contact, providing answers according to Company policies and protocols, or directing inquiries to the appropriate business unit to expedite customer satisfaction.

Education

An associate degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Business or related discipline. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

Experience

At least 3 years working in a similar strategic executive assistant role providing support to senior leaders in a large organization. 2+ years in project management or business operations in a software company highly preferred.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

  • Able to work in an autonomous manner, with a high amount of confidence and limited direction from leadership, to move work forward efficiently.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office products including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Proficiency in assisting senior leaders with departmental staffing and budget tracking
  • Experience with Concur for expense reporting and processing
  • Able to maintain the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality in all aspects of the role.
  • Strong organization and planning skills to effectively coordinate and manage multiple calendar appointments, meetings, and events, and anticipate and quickly modify arrangements when needed.
  • Able to build professional and collaborative working relationships across global teams, and with individuals outside the company.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, and can tailor communications to a specific audience.
  • Creative thinker with the ability to problem solve quickly.
  • Ability to analyze data and prepare insights and reports for executive decision making.
  • Ability to create compelling presentations for executive audiences based on introductory inputs from SVP and product teams including ideas for visuals and multi-media concepts that marketing can refine and finalize.
  • Flexible and adaptable approach to work, and can easily adjust to shifts in priorities or direction.
  • Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy.

Special Position Requirements

  • Must be available to work outside of normal business hours as needed, to accommodate special requests or to facilitate meetings/events that occur across global time zones/countries.

How We Work

  • We value collaboration, ownership, and pragmatic problem-solving.
  • We prioritize shared success over individual wins.
  • We encourage employees to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve how we build software.
  • We believe in modern practices, fast feedback loops, and creating great customer experiences.

What We Offer

  • Full benefits starting Day 1: Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • 401(k) with company matching up to 4%
  • Unlimited Paid Flex Time Off plus 10 company-paid annual holidays
  • Company-issued laptop
  • Monthly communication stipend
  • One-time home office equipment stipend upon hire
  • Professional development programs
  • Tuition assistance available after 1 year of service

      <title>Customer.io: Contract Accounts Payable Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Americas Remote
</p>

<h3>About <a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a></h3>
<p>Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.</p>
<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>Hi, my name is Eric Anderson, Senior Controller at <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a>, and I'm looking for an AP Contractor to keep our T&amp;E engine running clean through a busy stretch. Our Accounting team relies on Ramp and Navan to keep expense and travel spend moving, and we need someone who can own the day-to-day grind — coding, reconciling, chasing exceptions — without losing sight of the bigger picture. This is a 6-month contract with real ownership from day one, working closely with Terre Holmes and the AP team.</p>
<h3>What we value</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Ownership</strong> — you drive the exception queue to zero, not someone else.</li>
<li><strong>Directness</strong> — you enforce policy clearly and kindly, without dodging hard conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Precision</strong> — a mismatched dollar amount doesn't get past you.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What you’ll do</h3>
<ul>
<li>Own Ramp expense management end-to-end — review, code, and approve expense reports, chase missing receipts, and enforce policy compliance.</li>
<li>Administer Navan travel — reconcile bookings and spend, flag policy exceptions, and support employees through out-of-policy approvals.</li>
<li>Review AP bills for accuracy, coding, and approval routing — catching duplicate invoices and mismatched amounts before they hit the payment queue.</li>
<li>Reconcile Ramp and Navan activity against the GL and drive the exception queue to zero before every close.</li>
<li>Serve as the responsive point of contact for vendors — confirming payment details, tracking status, and resolving disputes.</li>
<li>Spot recurring T&amp;E headaches and propose (and document) process fixes.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What we're looking for</h3>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of AP &amp; T&amp;E experience, ideally in SaaS or a high-growth environment</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with Ramp and/or Navan (or comparable — Concur, Expensify, TravelPerk)</li>
<li>Sharp eye for detail and a solid grasp of expense policy enforcement</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li>
<li>Ability to manage a recurring, deadline-driven workload</li>
<li>Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP is a plus</li>
</ul>
<h3>Compensation &amp; Benefits</h3>
<p>This is a contracted engagement at <strong>$45–60/hr USD</strong>, depending on experience, for an estimated 6-month term.</p>
<h3>Our Process</h3>
<p>No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.</p>
<ol>
<li>30-minute video call with a Recruiter</li>
<li>45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager</li>
<li>45-minute cross-functional screen with a member of the AP team</li>
</ol>
<p>All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.</p>
<p><a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.</p>
<p>Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official <a href="http://customer.io/">Customer.io</a> letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact <a href="mailto:jobs@customer.io">jobs@customer.io</a>.</p>
<h3>Join us!</h3>
<p>Check out our&nbsp;<a href="https://customer.io/careers/">careers page</a>&nbsp;for more information about why you should&nbsp;<a href="https://customer.io/about/">come work with us!</a> We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-contract-accounts-payable-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-contract-accounts-payable-manager</a></p>
</description>

<p>

</p>

<p><strong>About us</strong></p>
<p>Steuart Nutrition is a GMP-certified contract manufacturer making powders, liquids, capsules and stick packs for growing wellness brands. We run on Extreme Ownership, clear communication and fast turnaround, and we want a developer who works the same way.</p>
<p><strong>The role</strong></p>
<p>We're hiring a remote developer to own the customization of our training app. You'll learn the platform quickly, then build what our teams need to train and onboard people. Over time you'll also take on other internal tools and automations. AI-assisted development is central to how we work, so we want someone who uses AI tools to write and ship better code faster.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Learn our training app inside and out, then customize and extend it</li>
<li>Build features, integrations and automations with AI coding tools like Claude, Cursor, Copilot and Grok</li>
<li>Turn rough requests from the plant and office teams into working solutions</li>
<li>Document your work so others can use it and maintain it</li>
<li>Give regular, clear progress updates</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of professional software development</li>
<li>Strong, proven skill with AI-assisted coding: you know how to prompt, check and fix AI-generated code</li>
<li>A track record of quickly learning unfamiliar platforms and codebases</li>
<li>Experience with APIs, web apps and integrations (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred)</li>
<li>Excellent written English and consistent communication</li>
<li>Able to overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Eastern Time</li>
<li>Bonus: experience with LMS or training platforms, or with manufacturing or regulated industries</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/steuart-nutrition-software-developer-ai-coding">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/steuart-nutrition-software-developer-ai-coding</a></p>

      <title>Glean: Application Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Glean is looking for an experienced <strong>Application Security Engineer</strong> with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w"><span>Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.</span></li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).</span></li>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).</span>&nbsp;</li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.</span></li>

      <title>Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0076/3373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, Arizona
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://adventuretravel365.com/">https://adventuretravel365.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web &amp; Mobile Platform</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a <strong>top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer</strong> to help us bring it to life.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think <strong>Thumbtack or Angi</strong>, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Help Us Build</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The platform will have two main sides: <strong>clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles</li>
<li>Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering</li>
<li>Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management</li>
<li>Job and project tracking</li>
<li>Client and vendor dashboards</li>
<li>Online payments and transaction tracking</li>
<li>Reviews and ratings</li>
<li>Notifications and communications</li>
<li>Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities</li>
<li>Admin tools for managing the platform</li>
<li>Reporting and analytics</li>
<li>Secure management of user, job, and transaction data</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to <strong>grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.</strong></p>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’d love to find someone with strong experience in <strong>full-stack web and mobile development</strong>, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-stack web development</li>
<li>Mobile or cross-platform app development</li>
<li>Strong front-end <strong>and</strong> back-end development</li>
<li>Multi-user marketplace platforms</li>
<li>User authentication and account management</li>
<li>Payment gateway integrations</li>
<li>Databases and APIs</li>
<li>Third-party integrations</li>
<li>Dashboards and reporting</li>
<li>Secure, scalable application architecture</li>
<li>Cloud hosting and deployment</li>
<li>Testing, maintenance, and optimization</li>
<li>Using modern <strong>AI-powered development tools</strong> and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">If you’ve worked on something similar to <strong>Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace</strong>, we definitely want to hear about it.</p>
<h2>More Than Just Coding</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also be expected to <strong>study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi</strong>, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be able to take the project through <strong>planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond</strong>, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important.</strong> You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is <strong>not a short-term build-and-leave project.</strong> We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.</p>
<h2>Interested? Tell Us About Yourself</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Please send us:</p>
<ul>
<li>A quick introduction</li>
<li>Your resume or LinkedIn profile</li>
<li>Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built</li>
<li>Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on</li>
<li>What <strong>you personally worked on</strong> for those projects</li>
<li>Your experience using AI in development</li>
<li>What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why</li>
<li>Your availability</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>A short video introduction would be great, too!</strong> Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.</p>
<p>Most importantly, <strong>show us what you’ve built.</strong> If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform</a></p>
</description>
